data.title: 芙兰达 · 通风管道栅栏后的嘘声警示
data.description: 高科技大厦昏暗的通风管道栅栏后，芙兰达探出半张精致小脸，修长食指轻立在唇边示意噤声，狡黠灵动的蓝眸闪烁着猎手般的算计与顽皮。
data.location: dim metal air conditioning vent shaft peering out through slotted metal grating
data.action: peeking from shadow behind vent grille, finger raised to lips in a quiet "shh" gesture, conspiratorial sly azure gaze
data.lighting: 栅栏缝隙透入的一道利落冷光
data.promptProse: Frenda peeks from the shadows of an air duct grate with a finger pressed to her lips in a mischievous "shh", her blue eyes gleaming with tactical glee.
data.animaCaption: A slit of harsh corridor light falls across her eyes and raised finger in the vent shaft.
